[element-xi-include]
=== `<xi:include>` XInclude

Adds the XInclude mechanism to the NISO STS Tag Set, so that standards and adoption documents can be managed as separate files and “included” as needed into a final document.

#### Usage/Remarks
For details concerning the use of XInclude, see https://www.w3.org/TR/xinclude/.
The optional <<element-xi-fallback,`<xi:fallback>`>> child can be used to specify alternative content when the resource to be included was not found.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-accept,`@accept`>>
* <<attribute-accept-language,`@accept-language`>>
* <<attribute-encoding,`@encoding`>>
* <<attribute-href,`@href`>>
* <<attribute-parse,`@parse`>> (default = xml)
* <<attribute-xpointer,`@xpointer`>>
#### Namespaces

* <<attribute-xmlns-xi,`@xmlns:xi`>> (fixed value = http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude)

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-adoption,`<adoption>`>>, <<element-adoption-front,`<adoption-front>`>>, <<element-app-group,`<app-group>`>>, <<element-back,`<back>`>>, <<element-body,`<body>`>>, <<element-front,`<front>`>>
#### Description

<<element-xi-fallback,`<xi:fallback>`>> <<element-xi-fallback,XInclude Fallback>>, zero or one

#### Tagged Sample

##### Structural components of a standard as included documents, not inline
[source,xml]
....
<standard  
  xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"
  xmlns:tbx="urn:iso:std:iso:30042:ed-1"
  xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"
  xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude"
  dtd-version="1.2"
  xml:lang="en">  
 <front>...</front>
 <body>
  <!-- Introduction is in file S-2295-Intro.xml -->
  <xi:include href="S-2295-Intro.xml" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude" parse="xml"/>

  <!-- Scope is in file S-2295-Scope.xml -->
  <xi:include href="S-2295-Scope.xml" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude" parse="xml"/>

  <!-- Terms and Defs section is in file S-2295-T-D.xml -->
  <xi:include href="S-2295-T-D.xml" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude" parse="xml"/>

  ... 
 </body>
</standard>
....
